fixture_contract.name: blg-d09-exact-sha-release-v1
fixture_contract.reset: Fresh isolated runner/container namespace and browser profile per case; remove generated artifacts, cache and receipts after each case. No production host, credential, live deploy, WB/Ozon or external egress is permitted.

coverage.requirement: One full SHA is built once and promoted only through its immutable manifest/artifact digests.
coverage.process_transition: selected candidate to prepared release package

coverage.requirement: Every applicable runtime reads back the candidate identity or release fails closed.
Browser receives candidate entry document and manifest-listed hashed bundle, including hard reload.
Failure or rollback uses only named immutable previous package and never claims data rollback.
coverage.process_transition: failed candidate to restored application package

cases.title: Known frontend-changing full-SHA candidate completes the exact release chain
cases.zone: candidate, manifest, runtime identity, browser receipt
cases.fixture: clean candidate C2 and previous C1 with distinct manifest-listed frontend assets
cases.fixture_builder: synthetic immutable archives/manifests and isolated containers; fresh browser
steps: Build once and validate canonical manifest/artifact digests.
Read back api, migrations, celery_worker, celery_beat and web identities.
Load visible screen then hard reload in browser.
cases.expected_api: API identity and container inspection report C2 SHA, manifest digest, backend image ID and OCI revision.
cases.expected_worker: Worker, beat and migrations each report C2 identity; migrations includes head and successful exit.
cases.read_back: All five runtime rows, manifest digest, archive/image digests and revision labels equal C2; no target rebuild occurs.
cases.reload_assertion: Final index URL, effective headers, loaded hashed JS URL/status/byte hash and visible screen bind to C2; hard reload resolves the same C2 asset, distinct from C1.
cases.oracle: S11 exact-SHA release outcome and S13 runtime/browser identity contract.

cases.title: Mutable, short, malformed or dirty source selection fails before build
cases.fixture: branch, tag, HEAD, latest, short SHA, uppercase SHA, unknown SHA and dirty tree variants
cases.read_back: No manifest, archive, runtime change or success receipt exists.
cases.oracle: S11/S13 full lowercase 40-character SHA and clean-builder requirement.

cases.title: Source drift or target-side rebuild cannot replace the selected build
cases.fixture: C2 selected, then altered builder tree and target checkout/rebuild attempt
steps: Inject tree drift or command requiring target source checkout.
cases.read_back: Build/promotion stops before runtime change; no substituted archive/image is accepted.
cases.oracle: S11 build-once requirement and S13 isolated-builder invariant.

cases.title: Manifest, archive, image or revision-label tampering fails closed
cases.fixture: C2 package with one substituted manifest byte, archive digest, image ID or OCI revision label
cases.read_back: Validator names the mismatch and current C1 runtime remains untouched; no success receipt.
cases.oracle: S11 digest mismatch stop and S13 manifest identity root.

cases.title: Missing or unknown runtime identity is a release failure
cases.fixture: C2 with each of api, migrations, celery_worker, celery_beat or web identity omitted or unknown in turn
steps: Remove or replace one required identity row.
cases.read_back: Release is failed; verifier names absent runtime and never downgrades it to warning/success.
cases.reload_assertion: Browser proof is not accepted after an incomplete runtime matrix.
cases.oracle: S11 fail-closed identity and S13 five-runtime matrix.

cases.title: Conflicting runtime SHA, manifest, image or migration identity stops partial release
cases.fixture: C2 where one runtime retains C1 image/identity or migrations report wrong head/exit
cases.read_back: Mismatch fails result and emits stop/rollback-required state rather than partial success.
cases.reload_assertion: Browser result cannot make a mixed runtime acceptable.
cases.oracle: S11 partial-service failure boundary and S13 runtime rows.

cases.title: Health, build log, curl or screenshot alone cannot prove release identity
cases.fixture: healthy API and successful build/log/screenshot fixtures with missing full runtime/browser chain
cases.read_back: Evidence gate rejects success and identifies missing manifest/runtime/browser fields.
cases.reload_assertion: N/A: no qualifying browser asset evidence exists.

cases.title: Stale index document pointing to C1 asset fails known frontend-changing candidate
cases.fixture: C2 runtime with index response referencing C1 hashed JS asset
steps: Load C2 page with stale index fixture.
Capture final index URL, headers and loaded assets.
cases.read_back: Loaded asset URL/hash is not manifest-listed C2 asset and release fails despite healthy C2 API.
cases.reload_assertion: Hard reload still loading C1 is explicit failure evidence.
cases.oracle: S11 known frontend-changing candidate rule and S13 browser bundle proof.

cases.title: Unlisted or byte-mismatched browser asset fails manifest lookup
cases.fixture: C2 index requests asset URL missing from manifest or serving bytes with a different SHA-256
steps: Compare URL and hash with C2 manifest.
cases.read_back: Browser receipt records mismatch and rejects success; visible screen alone is insufficient.
cases.reload_assertion: N/A: mismatch blocks acceptance before reload can qualify it.
cases.oracle: S11 manifest-linked asset requirement and S13 asset-byte requirement.

cases.title: Missing cache headers or hard reload proof cannot pass S23 closure evidence
cases.fixture: C2 asset proof with absent effective root/index headers or omitted hard reload observation
steps: Produce otherwise matching C2 browser evidence.
cases.read_back: S23 remains blocked; no `INTEGRATION_PASSED` and no resolution of BLK-RELEASE-001.
cases.reload_assertion: The omitted hard reload itself is the failed condition.
cases.oracle: BLK-RELEASE-001 minimum closure artifact and S11/S13 cache evidence requirement.

cases.title: Failed candidate rolls back only to named previous immutable manifest
cases.fixture: failed C2 plus retained verified C1 SHA, manifest digest and artifacts
steps: Cause C2 runtime or browser verification failure.
Read back all services and browser.
cases.read_back: All application runtime rows and browser asset bind to C1; receipt names failed C2 and restored C1 exactly and makes no data-rollback claim.
cases.reload_assertion: Hard reload resolves C1 manifest-listed asset after rollback.
cases.oracle: S11/S13 named rollback and honest data boundary.

cases.title: Missing, substituted or data-incompatible rollback artifact fails closed
cases.fixture: failed C2 with missing C1 artifact, mismatched C1 manifest/SHA, mutable ref or incompatible-data marker
cases.read_back: Rollback stops as release incident; it cannot choose another ref/SHA or rebuild approximation.
cases.reload_assertion: N/A: no unverified rollback browser proof may be emitted.
cases.oracle: S13 rollback failure boundary and S14 rollback-substitution attack.
